analysis: The PR removes console-UI developer tooling: .githooks/pre-commit and .githooks/pre-push (both only lint/build console-ui), .github/dependabot.yml (npm security-update grouping for /console-ui, with open-pull-requests-limit 0), and the lint-console CI job plus its routing lane in .github/workflows/ci.yml (base lines 37 and 638-658). No provider, coordinator wire, attestation, key custody, cache, fan-helper or add-on code is touched. The removed pieces are not mapped to any threat-model asset, boundary or mitigation: the retained definitions (T-041 prefix cache, TB-002/003/007/009/010/011/012 provider boundaries) do not depend on console-ui checks. The scope statement lists the consumer console and admin UI as out of scope. The ci.yml edit leaves the provider lanes, provider-test-gate, release-integrity and docs jobs untouched. Permissions stay contents: read. The provider-test-gate needs list never referenced lint-console, so no required-check gate is broken inside the supplied file. Residual unverified items: (1) whether console-ui still exists in the repo, since the hook comments say 'retained console', so removing its lint/test/build CI and Dependabot would drop automated npm vulnerability alerts for it. That is a supply-chain hygiene regression for an out-of-scope component, not a provider-boundary issue. (2) Whether the component-changes.yml workflow's console output or a branch-protection rule still references the lint-console job; that is outside the supplied evidence. (3) Whether other workflows or docs reference the removed hooks; not shown. No concrete security regression against the in-scope threat model was identified.
